About us

InCred is a new-age financial services group that leverages technology & data-science to make lending quick & easy. InCred is credit for Incredible India. We use technology & data-science to make lending quick, simple & hassle-free. We believe traditional ways of lending can exclude those most in need because of outdated, rigid & often inefficient processes. At InCred, we have simplified the lending process with a sharp focus on serving our borrowers’ unique needs & circumstances. Our Products: Personal Loans Student Loans Secured Business Loans Specialised MSME Loans Loans to Financial Institutions

“AI will make humans leapfrog a generation of technology. Fraud is an arms race.”

Two powerful perspectives on the future of consumer finance, shared by Prithvi Chandrasekhar, Head - Consumer Finance, InCred Finance.

From leveraging AI to drive innovation to staying ahead in the evolving landscape of fraud and risk, the conversation highlights the need to balance ambition with vigilance.

🎧 Tune in to the conversation now.


Spotify - https://lnkd.in/daHWWapq

YouTube - https://lnkd.in/dxeTZNji

#InCredFinance #ArtificialIntelligence #ConsumerFinance #FraudPrevention #RiskManagement #Fintech #Leadership

Rajit Bhattacharya
1w

Episode 2 of Trust Dialogues is live.

This one is with Prithvi Chandrasekhar, CEO (Consumer Finance) at InCred Financial Services.

Two things he said have stayed with me since we recorded.

"AI will make humans leapfrog a generation of technology."

"Fraud is an arms race."

The first is about ambition. Lenders in India do not have to work through every layer of tooling the West built over thirty years. The second is about humility. With AI, new weapons are available on both sides. Every control you build is studied, and the person studying it now has the same tools you do.

Running a consumer finance business means holding both of those at once, and Prithvi does it with more candour than most CEOs allow themselves on record.

▶️ YouTube: https://lnkd.in/dMVNruaf

🎧 Spotify: https://lnkd.in/dPCCVpNF

If you work in credit, risk or fraud, this one is worth your time. A like, comment or subscribe helps us bring more of these conversations to you.

Tripti Tandon Aisik Paul Ankit Das Monish Parekh Punitpal Singh Anand datasutram.ai
